samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Why might people support the proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons? Is this a positive or negative development?
requirementsVi: Trả lời vì sao có người ủng hộ.
Đánh giá tích cực hay tiêu cực và giải thích.
Thừa nhận điều kiện, kết cả hai câu trả lời.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. This is possible because recorded lessons can be watched again at a convenient time. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that some learners may feel isolated. This is connected with the fact that courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. For example, a teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
paragraphs.noteVi: Minh họa cách giữ lợi ích và giảm trở ngại.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because students can discover routes that match practical interests. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt cả lý do và đánh giá.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that communities should provide more affordable classes for adults. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời ngắn cả hai câu hỏi.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that adults can update skills without returning to full-time study. This is possible because short local courses can fit around work and caring responsibilities. For example, a shop assistant can attend an evening computer class to learn how to manage simple spreadsheets. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. This is connected with the fact that course providers may focus on fees while overlooking practical access. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đánh giá có lý do và giới hạn.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện

This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.
